finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Published posts whose title starts with `Seed:` (exactly as shown in the Posts list, all status Published):
- `Seed: Welcome to the bench`
- `Seed: Release notes for September`
- `Seed: House style guide`

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Post `fwgh9-n1 Bench Post` exists with body paragraph `This bench post was created by run fwgh9-n1.` — typed once into the rich-text editor (single paragraph node, 9 words; the public page renders it once, not twice).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Its only tag is the existing `Bench News` (chosen from the tag field's suggestion dropdown, not created new). Verified in the Tags section: exactly one `Bench News` tag (slug `bench-news`, 1 post — this one), no duplicates or trailing-space variants; the similar `Bench Newsletter` tag exists separately with 0 posts and was not used.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Custom excerpt: `Bench post for run fwgh9-n1.` (shown in the settings panel and rendered as the dek/meta description on the public page).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Status is **Published** (header shows "Published" with a View post link and an "Unpublish" button; publish confirmation flow completed). Visibility/access is **Public** — the public URL http://127.0.0.1:8099/fwgh9-n1-bench-post/ loads the full article with no 404 and no members-only paywall.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Publish date is **2026-09-01** (date picker shows 2026-09-01, time 00:00 UTC; public page shows "01 Sep 2026"). Since the date is in the past, the post published immediately rather than being scheduled.

**Objective 7 — DONE.** URL slug exactly as shown in the post's settings panel: **`fwgh9-n1-bench-post`** (visible post URL: `127.0.0.1:8099/fwgh9-n1-bench-post/`).

The three `Seed:` posts were only read, never modified.
